outcomes.q: What were my total sales last month?

outcomes.q: Total sales this month

outcomes.q: What is the revenue for this financial year?
outcomes.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue),2) AS revenue FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-11-17'

outcomes.q: How many orders did we get last week?
outcomes.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS orders_last_week FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-11-09' AND '2026-11-15'

outcomes.q: Total units sold in the last 7 days

outcomes.q: What were total expenses last month?

outcomes.q: How much did we purchase from suppliers this month?

outcomes.q: What was the average order value last month?

outcomes.q: How much revenue came from Sundays in the last 30 days?

outcomes.q: Top 5 products by revenue last month
outcomes.sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(revenue),2) AS revenue FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY sku, product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

outcomes.q: Top 10 products by units sold this month

outcomes.q: Which 5 products made the most profit in the last 30 days?
outcomes.sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(gross_profit),2) AS profit FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-10-19' AND '2026-11-17' GROUP BY sku, product_name ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 5

outcomes.q: Bottom 5 products by revenue last month, among products that sold

outcomes.q: Top 3 named customers by revenue in the last 90 days

outcomes.q: Compare last month's gross profit with the month before

outcomes.q: What is the percentage growth in revenue of last month over the month before?
outcomes.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (rev_last - rev_before) / NULLIF(rev_before,0), 2) AS revenue_growth_pct FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS rev_last, SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS rev_before FROM v_sales)

outcomes.q: Which category grew the most in rupees last month compared to the month before?
outcomes.sql:
WITH rev AS (SELECT category,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS rev_last,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS rev_prev
 FROM v_sales
 WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-10-31'
 GROUP BY category)
SELECT category,
       ROUND(rev_last - rev_prev, 2) AS growth_rupees
FROM rev
ORDER BY growth_rupees DESC
LIMIT 1;
